text:
elena: Quick idea 1-week PLG sprint: 'LaunchSpark' 1 live 30m demo + on-demand clips + Prompt Starter Pack + 100 credits auto-grant. Goal: increase signup -> first-generate within 48h by ~25%. :sparkles:

sam: Nice. Primary metric = % of new signups that call /v1/generate at least once within 48h. Secondary = day7 retention and credit redemption rate.

jun: Ops Q: how should webinar registrants be routed? Auto-cohort them into `launchspark-credit` and call the promo API to issue credits? We should exclude corp domains.

maya: Yes. Flow: registration webhook -> growth-webhooks -> promo service -> email with starter pack + one-click "Run sample". Promo API endpoint: `/v1/internal/promos/issue` (internal).

sam: Tracking params: utm_source=social, utm_medium=organic|paid, utm_campaign=launchspark, prompt_pack=starter. Amplitude events: webinar_signup, promo_issued, first_generate. I'll create a small dashboard for same-day monitoring.

elena: Experiment arms proposal: A) 100 credits + prompt pack (baseline) B) 200 credits + prompt pack C) 100 credits + inline guided console tour that highlights runnable templates. Target ~300 signups/arm.

jun: Also test nudge cadence: immediate email with runnable prompt, 12h reminder with screenshot + tip, 36h quick guide on cost controls. We can measure email->first_generate conversion for each step.

maya: Copy angle ideas: 1) Developer-first: "Run real prompts now" 2) Product-first: "Ship features faster with starter prompts" 3) Benchmark tease: "See latency & cost on a real 256-token example". Keep social posts short and A/B headlines.

sam: Exclude enterprise by domain list; flag those signups for sales follow-up instead of auto-credit. We'll also add a small consent checkbox for promo issuance on the registration form.

elena: Promo text in email should be clear: 'You've been granted 100 credits. Try this sample prompt now -> [Run sample]'. Include copy-paste prompt snippet and link to docs + one-click run where possible.

jun: For experimentation, define primary hypothesis: runnable prompt + credits increases first-run by +20-30%. Secondary hypotheses: higher credit amounts improve depth-of-use; guided tour increases retention.

maya: Ops checklist: copy + socials (elena/chris), promo ID & email templates (jun), webhook & cohort routing (sam), experiment splits & dashboard (sam/aaron), guided tour prototype (product). Tag @here when assets live.

promo-bot: Promo created: id=LS-2025-100, auto_issue=true, campaign=launchspark.

product-bot: Webinar scheduled: LaunchSpark: Prompt Starter Lab on 2025-10-14 18:00 UTC. Registration page: https://redwood.ai/webinar/launchspark

elena: Let's sync 15m tomorrow 9:30am PT to finalize copy and assign owners. Keep it focused so we can launch fast and iterate. :rocket:
